name: updateResponsibilityStatus
shortDescription: Changes the status of an existing responsibility (e.g., in_progress, completed, blocked), updating its progression.
description:
Overview

Modifies the status of an existing Responsibility record.

Intended use

Called by Lead Points or Stumps from the Responsibility and Deliverable Management UI, or by an AI agent, to update task progress. Parameters include responsibilityId and newStatus.

Logic

  1. Retrieve the Responsibility record using params.responsibilityId via ctx.data.get. If not found, return an error.
  2. Verify that the ctx.user_id matches the idOfUser on the Responsibility record, or that the user has the leadPoint or admin role. If not, return an unauthorized error.
  3. Validate params.newStatus against allowed Responsibility.status enum values. If invalid, return an error.
  4. Update the Responsibility record's status attribute using ctx.data.update.
  5. If newStatus is 'completed', set completedAt to the current timestamp.
  6. Audit-log the responsibility status update using ctx.audit.log, including the responsibility ID and new status.
  7. Return the updated Responsibility record.

Entities

  • Responsibility
